summary: Iteration 25 = Plan v4 confirmation/regression pass on the live-auth build. Minted OWNER (owner.qa@emergent.sh, role=owner) + REVIEWER (vishal.k@emergent.sh, role=member) Mongo sessions via iter23_setup.py. BACKEND (22/22 pytest passed, /app/backend/tests/test_iter25_planv4.py, xml at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter25_results.xml): (1) AUTH GATE — /api/auth/me + /projects/{pid}/activity + /assignments + /trash all 401 without a token; owner/reviewer /auth/me return correct roles. (2) PART 5 PERMISSIONS REVERSAL — reviewer PUT /projects/{pid}/documents/{id} on a NON-assigned doc => 200 (open to any signed-in user; content restored after test), reviewer POST /projects/{pid}/documents => 200 (throwaway then soft-deleted + purged), reviewer POST /projects/{pid}/comments => 200 and reviewer POST /comments/{id}/resolve => 200. (3) OWNER-ONLY GATES + MESSAGING — reviewer publish/unpublish/create-assignment/GET activity all 403 with detail 'Only an owner can do this. Please contact: sarang@emergent.sh …'; reviewer DELETE on a PUBLISHED page => 403 with detail 'This page is published — only an owner can delete it. Please contact: sarang@emergent.sh …'. (4) VERDICT GATING — reviewer POST /verdicts on assigned slug (put-your-app-live) => 200; reviewer POST /verdicts on unassigned slug => 403 'You can only add a verdict to pages assigned to you'; owner verdict on any slug => 200. (5) SOFT DELETE / TRASH — reviewer delete non-published page returns {'message':'Document moved to Trash'}, page disappears from GET /documents + public default-project + /seo/sitemap.xml, appears in GET /trash with days_left=90 and deleted_by_name='Vishal K'; POST /restore-page brings it back into /documents; DELETE /trash/{id} permanently removes it. (6) THREADS + MENTIONS — POST /comments with parent_id stored a reply (visible with parent_id in GET list); mentions normalised to lowercase ('Sarang@Emergent.sh' -> 'sarang@emergent.sh'); GET /projects/{pid}/known-emails returns non-empty @emergent.sh list to a REVIEWER (open per Plan v4). (7) ACTIVITY LOG — GET /activity owner-only (reviewer 403 with contact msg); items returned newest-first with a 'people' distinct list; ?person=vishal.k@emergent.sh filter returns only that actor; GET /activity/page/mdx-editor-staging accessible to reviewer; a fresh reviewer PUT generated an 'edited' entry with actor_email='vishal.k@emergent.sh' for that page. (8) ASSIGNED-BY — POST /assignments as owner stored assigned_by_name='QA Owner' and GET /assignments returned it. FRONTEND (Playwright, preview URL, cookie auth): Review Console as OWNER — all 6 tabs visible (review-tab-overview/assignments/inbox/publish/team/activity), Activity tab renders activity-feed (23 rows) + activity-person-filter (Everyone/owner.qa/vishal.k), selecting a person re-renders; Assignments tab body contains 'assigned by' text on assignment rows. Review Console as REVIEWER — only review-tab-assignments (count for overview/inbox/publish/team/activity all 0), header badge 'Reviewer'. Review Page /review/put-your-app-live as reviewer — reviewpage-history-btn opens page-history-panel; new-comment-input typing 'Hey @sar' opens mention-menu with mention-opt-sarang@emergent.sh. Editor /admin/editor/{pid} as OWNER — trash-btn opens trash-panel; a pre-seeded trashed doc appears as trash-item-<id> with trash-restore-<id> + trash-purge-<id>; clicking Restore removed the item from the panel and toasted 'Restored QA trash editor' — verified via toast + item count = 0 after restore. ALL TEMPORARY DATA CLEANED: qa_sess_* sessions dropped, owner.qa user removed, throwaway trash docs deleted + purged, temporary verdicts removed, qa-iter25-* activity_log entries pruned; final state: 121 docs, 0 published, 0 trashed, 0 reviewer_marked, owner_invites=[sarang@emergent.sh], 0 qa sessions.
action_items: STILL OPEN from iter23/iter24 (cosmetic, unchanged): first 2-3 /api/auth/me and /api/roles/me calls on every protected page load return 401 (console 'AxiosError') before identical retries succeed. Reproduced again on /admin/review load. Server side is fine (curl 200 consistently) — this is a frontend double-mount / credential-timing issue and could flash an unauthenticated state briefly.

STILL OPEN from iter24 (low): reviewers still see 'New Tab' and per-page '...' controls in the Editor; server-side owner gate correctly 403s the underlying PUT /config, but the UI silently reverts with no toast.
critical_code_review_comments: review_routes.py _owner_only + _owner_contact_str now uniformly guard publish, unpublish, create_assignment, delegate, roles/owners, roles/promote, review/inbox, review/progress and GET /activity — good. Consider making _owner_only a FastAPI Dependency (Depends(owner_dep)) so a new route can't be added ungated by mistake (same suggestion as iter24 for server.py).

server.py delete_document owner-gates ONLY published pages (line 804); by design reviewers can now delete drafts/in_review pages (Plan v4). Confirmed behaviour is correct but note that trash retention is 90 days — a malicious reviewer could still trash 120 pages before it's caught; consider surfacing a Trash review notification for owners.

server.py restore_page (line 862) does NOT gate on role; any signed-in user can restore any trashed page. This is consistent with Plan v4 'everything except publish/unpublish/verdict-non-assigned is open', but worth documenting so it isn't perceived as a regression.
server.py get_documents (line 625) still returns all 121 docs to reviewers — see iter24 note; unchanged.
